texts.content_exam: Suzan is an orphan whose father died when she was a baby. Before his death, he had a strong will of taking care of Suzan and encouraging her to study hard. After her husband's death, the mother worked hard to make her daughter feel comfortable and tried to afford her all what she needed. At night, before they sleep, the mother tells Suzan how much it is important to be a responsible citizen who respects the principles of the country. She encourages her daughter to be a productive member of society and a person who makes a positive contribution to the nation. The mother also clarifies the necessity of developing her daughter's character to be strong and effective in society.

questions.question: What happened to Suzan's father?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: He died

questions.question: What does Suzan's mother teach her at night?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: To be a responsible citizen

questions.question: What did Suzan's father encourage her to do before his death?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: Study hard (encouraging her to study hard).

questions.question: What does the mother clarify the necessity of developing?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: Her daughter's character (developing her daughter's character).

questions.question: What kind of member does the mother encourage Suzan to be?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: A productive member of society (a productive member of society).

texts.content_exam: She tells her that she must understand her legal rights as well as her duties. Suzan is sure that life is difficult when you cannot have what you want. But she has learnt from her mother to fight till the end. She always says: 'when we don't have what we like, we must like what we have'. Suzan, who is now 15 years old, works hard to achieve her dreams. She loves reading so she spends her free time in the school library reading about her country's history and social studies. She studies a lot because she believes that what is hard today, will be easy tomorrow and what is black tonight will be white in the morning.

questions.question: Suzan's motto is 'when we don't have what we like, we must like what we have'.
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: True

questions.question: Suzan is 20 years old now.
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: False (She is 15 years old).

questions.question: Suzan spends her free time in the school library.
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: True

questions.question: What does Suzan believe about what is hard today?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: She believes it will be easy tomorrow.

questions.question: Where does Suzan spend her free time?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: In the school library reading about her country's history.

texts.content_exam: Mariam was a teacher who wanted to motivate her students and make them do their best in the exam. So, she told them that she would give a gift, which was a new pair of shoes, to the one whose marks would be excellent. Children rejoiced over this challenge and they all started writing diligently. After collecting the papers, the teacher was surprised to find that everyone had a full mark. Who would get the gift? she thought. The teacher thanked everyone for their effort but she was confused about who would deserve the award as everyone had got the full mark. The teacher thought of a suitable solution with her students. The students' opinion was that each of them would write his/her name on a folded paper and put it in a box from which the teacher would pick one.

questions.question: What was the gift that Mariam promised her students?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: A new pair of shoes

questions.question: What did the teacher discover after collecting the papers?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: Everyone had a full mark

questions.question: What did the students suggest to choose the winner?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: Write names on folded paper

questions.question: Why was the teacher confused?
options: Because everyone got a full mark
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: Because everyone got a full mark (confused about who would deserve the award as everyone had got the full mark).

questions.question: What was the students' opinion to solve the problem?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: Writing names on folded papers (The students' opinion was that each of them would write his/her name on a folded paper).

texts.content_exam: So, the paper would reveal the name of the award's winner. Indeed, the teacher picked a paper in front of all students and read the child's name [Nada], and said: 'you are the owner of the award'. With joy and tears in her eyes, Nada came forward where the shoes were. She thanked everyone for this wonderful gift. Her parents couldn't afford to buy her new shoes because of their extreme poverty. The teacher returned home crying and told her husband what had happened. He was surprised and wanted to know the reason of her tears. She said: 'When I opened the rest of the papers, I found that all the students had written the same name [Nada]'.

questions.question: The teacher returned home laughing happily.
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: False (She returned home crying).

questions.question: All the students had written the same name Nada on their papers.
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: True

questions.question: Nada thanked everyone for the wonderful gift.
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: True (She thanked everyone for this wonderful gift).

questions.question: Why did all the students write Nada's name?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: They knew her family was poor and wanted her to have the shoes.

questions.question: What did the teacher tell her husband?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: She told him that all the students had written the same name Nada.
